name: Yamakawa Kojirou
source:
He's the able young head of the yakuza group known as Higurashikai, which is based in Edogawa. He never believed in ghosts or other supernatural phenomena, but after witnessing a Gate Keepers exorcism first-hand, he begins to dip his toes into their organization. He carries a revolver and bullets designed to deal damage to spirits.

[From [url=http://www.nisamerica.com/games/tokyotwilightghosthunters/characters/]official website[/url]]
